name: CUAEWS DF passive RF sensor (SRC)
description: Passive find-and-fix half of the LIDS EW element. Searches the RF environment for signals of interest, direction-finds lines of bearing to both the UAS and its operator, and classifies each contact SUSPECT, NEUTRAL/UNKNOWN or FRIEND before the jammer half fires. No detection range is published: the ring is REPRESENTATIVE. The brochure's 8 km is the EW EFFECTS range and belongs to lib-cuaews.

classifyRangeM.condition: classification range — REPRESENTATIVE, set equal to detectRangeM. Basis: for a passive RF set the detection event IS the classification event - the brochure states the system 'classifies SOI using combat ID matrix as SUSPECT, NEUTRAL/UNKNOWN, or FRIEND' as part of the FIND step. This matches the convention the RF-domain agent used for lib-wingman, lib-rfpatrol, lib-ardronis and lib-titan.
classifyRangeM.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure (marked Approved for Public Release), CUAEWS DF FIND sequence
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 6000 m at UNKNOWN REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: azimuth coverage — INFERRED planning value, not a measured beam. Basis: the emplacement is a 156.5 in guyed tower, 38 in diameter, the DF works by 'capturing high-speed signals common to modern communications links using multiple detectors optimized for creating Lines of Bearing', and the system 'automatically resumes passive RF search upon cease fire' - all of which describe a persistent all-round posture. This matches the reasoning the EW-domain agent used for the jammer half.
sectorDeg.source: SRC, LIDS Family of Systems brochure (marked Approved for Public Release), CUAEWS DF physical characteristics and CAPABILITIES

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single-site RF direction finder measures bearing, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Class median of the sourced classification RF sensors: lib-titan 1, lib-rf360 5; median 3 deg.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Two-dimensional RF direction finding gives no elevation; not established by the public record.

receiverSensitivityDbm.note: Planning factor, 2.4 GHz band, channel-integrated: kTB for a 10 MHz OcuSync-class channel (-104 dBm) plus a 12 dB receiver noise figure (Narda SignalShark C-UAS application note) gives -92 dBm, recorded as -90 dBm. The SRC Whisper Hunter direction-finder sheet gives 395 to 6000 MHz and four coherent channels but no sensitivity. No passive RF sensor in the library publishes one.

geolocationMinNodes.condition: four-element array, four coherent receive channels, maximum-likelihood direction finding that 'provides lines of bearing'; two sites is the cross-bearing minimum
geolocationMinNodes.source: SRC Whisper Hunter direction finder product sheet (PDF)
